# One checkout-relative V8 test path per line. A plain path runs as an expected
# failure. Put "# SKIP: reason" directly above a path to skip execution.
# An unexpected pass or a missing path fails the suite.

test/intl/general/empty-handle.js

# Ekuma drops the islamic-rgsa calendar extension from the resolved locale.
test/intl/date-format/check-ca-option.js

# V8 canonicalizes GMT and Zulu to UTC.
test/intl/date-format/timezone.js

# Ekuma uses lookup matching for the best-fit locale matcher.
test/intl/localematcher/bestfit-supplemental-files.js

# V8 uses the scientific exponent for CLDR's compact exponent operand and
# rounds the scaled significand. ECMA-402 ResolvePlural rounds the full input.
test/intl/plural-rules/select.js

# The tests compare the wording of V8's exception messages.
test/intl/regress-10438.js
test/intl/regress-10613.js
test/intl/regress-9464.js
test/intl/regress-9747.js

# Umm al-Qura's civil fallback gives 16 and 17 Dhu al-Hijjah on July 22 and 23
# of ISO year -195366. Arithmetic year -202003 is era year 202004 BH.
# CLDR 49 Arabic inherits "BH" from root. V8 expects -202003 with the AH label.
test/intl/regress-10526.js

# islamic resolves to islamic-tbla. Its epoch is 0622-07-18 (1 Muharram 1 AH),
# so July 17 is 29 Dhu al-Hijjah 1 BH. V8 expects 30 Dhu al-Hijjah 0 AH.
# V8 expects both dates for islamic-rgsa too. Ekuma drops that unsupported
# extension and formats July 17 and 18 in the default Gregorian calendar for ar.
test/intl/regress-10527.js

# V8's English short time zone name at offset zero is GMT+0.
test/intl/regress-1074578.js

# V8 formats the first year of the Reiwa era as 元年.
test/intl/regress-10960.js

# Ekuma accepts the language tag de-u-22300-true-x-true.
test/intl/regress-1427932.js
test/intl/regress-412149700.js

# Ekuma uses the en-US date field order with the ISO calendar.
test/intl/regress-1451943.js

# Ekuma rejects the obsolete US/Pacific-New time zone.
test/intl/regress-364374.js

# V8 includes a localized time zone name in Date.prototype.toString().
test/intl/regress-7770.js

# Ekuma segments Thai words without ICU's dictionary.
test/intl/segmenter/word-containing.js
